purpose: Production raster skins and hardware sprites for NoiseBase

assets.name: walnut
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production raster background skin for a working audio VST, not a screenshot mockup. Generate a NEW photorealistic straight-on photograph of a completely BLANK vintage studio rack faceplate. The attached image is a layout/proportion reference only; replace its flat vector materials with believable photographed metal and real wood. Preserve the canvas aspect ratio 960:668 (ideally 1920x1336 or a proportional high-resolution landscape image), perfectly orthographic, no perspective, no depth tilt, no room around it. Entire canvas is filled by the rectangular equipment front.
Material: warm champagne anodized aluminium faceplate, subtle irregular fine brushing, very restrained wear, realistic machined edges and shadow depth; beautiful dark walnut wood side cheeks occupying the leftmost and rightmost 3.75% of the canvas, with natural nonrepeating wood grain running vertically. The metal starts at x=3.75%, y=2.25%, ends at x=96.25%, y=97.75%. Four real slotted steel mounting screws centered at normalized positions (5%,4.8%), (95%,4.8%), (5%,95.2%), (95%,95.2%). Soft diffuse studio lighting from upper left, realistic material microtexture, restrained premium 1970s studio hardware.
CRITICAL: remove ALL the reference's meters, knobs, buttons, toggles, lamps, text, logos, numerals, scales, engraved lines, wells, holes and displays. The entire central metal panel must be blank uninterrupted material, with no rectangles or control placeholders. Only the four outer mounting screws remain. No extra screws, no borders cutting through the blank faceplate. This is a usable photographic background; live functional controls and crisp labels will be composited separately by the app. No SVG/vector/illustration look, no watermark.

assets.name: knob
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: production transparent PNG rotary knob sprite for a photoreal analog audio plug-in. A SINGLE black bakelite vintage studio rotary knob with a precision silver aluminium knurled outer rim. Perfectly circular, perfectly straight-on orthographic front view, centered, fills 88% of a square canvas, no perspective tilt. Real photographed microtexture, restrained wear, concentric machined detail, very fine realistic grip ridges, subtle soft light from upper left. Black face gently domed, subtle edge bevel and real depth, not a flat vector disk. No pointer, no index stripe, no dots, no letters, no numeric scale, no surrounding equipment. The indicator is animated separately in software. Truly transparent background around the circular knob, no checkerboard baked in, no cast shadow extending far outside the circular rim. Clean antialiased silhouette, premium realistic studio hardware.

assets.name: meter
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: production transparent PNG analog meter housing for a real audio plug-in. SINGLE empty vintage studio VU-meter window, perfectly front-facing orthographic, horizontally rectangular width:height 260:150 (1.733:1). Tight canvas framing. A deep charcoal bakelite bezel with narrow machined metal chamfer, dark inner lip, genuine subtle glass reflection and warm ivory paper inside. The blank cream paper window fills about x=5%..95%, y=5%..95% of the outer rectangle, with a slim bezel; corners softly rounded. Realistic photographed hardware, upper-left studio lighting, gentle amber warmth, restrained wear, no cartoon or vector appearance. CRITICAL: no needle, no pivot, no numbers, no scale ticks, no labels, no text, no logo, no screws on the paper. All scale markings and moving needles will be drawn by the app. Paper face must be blank, evenly illuminated and legible; no strong reflection blocking its center. Transparent background outside the isolated housing. One meter only.

assets.name: switches
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Production PNG two-state sprite atlas for a real audio plug-in. Two images of the SAME small vintage chrome toggle switch, perfectly front-facing orthographic, side by side in a two-column atlas. Each column has an equally sized square cell. Left cell: lever flipped unmistakably UP. Right cell: lever flipped unmistakably DOWN. Exact same black rounded mounting recess and circular brushed-metal pivot nut, same position and size within each cell; only the lever changes. Stubby chrome lever with rounded cap and a clear 16-pixel-equivalent travel at 32-pixel display height. Compact hardware, roughly square silhouette, photographed realistic metal and shadows, upper-left studio light, no perspective. Center each switch at x=25% and75%, y=50%, with generous transparent separation. Truly transparent background, no text, labels, arrows, lines, diagrams or borders. No vector appearance. Two states only, no extra switches.

assets.name: buttons
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Production PNG two-state sprite atlas for physical push-buttons in a real audio plug-in. Two images of the SAME blank slim rectangular black bakelite push-button with narrow satin aluminium bevel and a black mounting gasket. Front-facing orthographic close-up, perfectly straight, each button about 4:1 width:height, softly squared corners, realistic photographed material microtexture and light from upper left. Left half of canvas: released/up button with subtly raised cap, natural edge depth. Right half: pressed/down version with clearly inset cap and changed edge shadow. Put each button at the center of an equally sized square cell in a two-column sheet, x=25% and75%, y=50%; keep sizes identical. Truly transparent background and generous transparent separation, no surrounding faceplate. Absolutely no letters, logo, icons, scale or markings, because functional text will be overlaid. No vector or SVG look, no decorative extra buttons.

assets.name: lamps
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Production transparent PNG four-state indicator jewel sprite atlas for a real vintage audio plug-in. Four isolated identical small round glass indicator jewels in a neat 2x2 grid, each centered in its own equal square cell. Same slim polished chrome retaining ring and convex translucent glass lens in every cell, front-facing orthographic, upper-left soft studio light, photographed hardware detail. Top-left: softly glowing warm AMBER lens. Top-right: softly glowing GREEN lens. Bottom-left: softly glowing RED lens. Bottom-right: UNLIT dark amber-brown lens. Keep the lens glow restrained, no large bloom or halo outside the ring. Each jewel fills about 75% of its cell. Truly transparent background, no wires, panel, text, labels, arrows, separators or extra objects. Exact four cells, no vector appearance.
